short_release_notes: Requires signed updater 1.0.102; use the complete Pi installer to update both components. Includes guarded application restart-loop recovery, bounded receiver recovery, privacy controls and receive diagnostics. Preserves registration, credentials, location, receiver settings and reporting choices. Exact installer upgrade, retry, reboot, check-ins and all configured receiver windows were qualified on the owned RTL bench. Live RF reporting and other hardware qualification remain separate.
